text:
sara-marketing: Planning a single "Virtual Launch Office Hours" on 2026-06-08. Need: reg page copy in EN/DE/JP, Zoom template, transcript/captions flow, clip generation, and SFDC lead routing. Who owns what?
miguel-ops: I can provision Zoom + webhooks. Suggest no waiting room, auto-transcript, cloud recording. Passcode OFF to reduce friction; use unique join links.
rachel-growth: Agree on passcode OFF for conversion. Reg form should include locale, event_intent (benchmark|demo|general), and a checkbox: "Yes, send me highlights and short clips (I consent)" with link to privacy.
meera-analytics: Lead scoring formula proposal: base 20 if attended + watch_pct*0.4 + chat_msgs*5 + clip_download*10. Normalize to 0-100 -> SFDC Event_Score__c. >=60 -> SDR task, >=80 -> AE immediate delivery.
clip-bot: clip-bot: After recording, will produce VTT + up to 5 auto-clips using speaker turn + keyword salience. Clips saved to s3://events/launch2026/{locale}/. Emit SNS /events/clip-ready with metadata.
video-team: We can trim and add a 30s locale-specific "lead_spark" clip within 24h if auto-clips are available. Need naming convention.
miguel-ops: Naming convention: `{event}/{locale}/YYYYMMDD/clip_{n}_{start_ms}_{end_ms}.mp4` with sidecar JSON: title, speakers, start_ms, end_ms, keywords, score, clip_priority.
legal: Consent language ok as long as privacy link included and opt-out instructions in follow-ups.
opsbot: opsbot: Webhook created: /zoom/recordings/launch2026 -> will place raw mp4 + vtt under /full/{locale}/. Retention raw=90d, processed clips=365d for AE.
meera-analytics: Also capture `watched_full` boolean (watch_pct>90) and push to SFDC. Include First_Touch_Channel__c mapping from UTM.
rachel-growth: Follow-up cadence: immediate thank-you+calendar; 24h highlight reel (3 clips) localized; 48h AE nudge for high-score leads; 7d nurture drip. Localized templates will be dropped here.
sara-marketing: Final checklist: miguel -> Zoom + webhook by 6/1; rachel -> localized reg pages by 6/2; meera -> SFDC fields + test by 6/3; video-team -> confirm trim SLA. I'll post EN copy in thread EOD.
video-team: Confirmed SLA 24h for lead_spark trims if clip_priority flagged. Please add `clip_priority` boolean in metadata.
sara-marketing: Thanks all! small note: add subtitle burn-in option for JP. rachel please surface a "need subtitles" checkbox on form.
miguel-ops: Will include subtitle flag from reg form -> clip metadata mapping.
opsbot: opsbot: Test event created and webhook test passed on 2026-05-04 16:12 UTC.
